method: Status intervals follow calendar boundaries. Medians use only available daily readings; sleep values are displayed as hours and minutes. PEM-family counts include crash-documented dates; weekly rates use documented diary dates per complete Monday--Sunday week with >=5 structured PEM-assessment or detailed timed diary dates; require >=3 qualified weeks. Sparse and partial weeks are excluded and the actual adequately tracked window is stated. Short, explicitly documented crash episodes can be described qualitatively. Rates do not estimate clinical attack incidence or missing periods. No interpolation. Dates of month-level milestones are approximated at month start.
